about: What the old path (AnalysisService.spectrum_slice, pair_spectrum) answered for the Tracks screen's cursor spectrum and pair figure, recorded before those replies and the recorder were removed. python-backend/test_tracks_answers.py holds the kept answers (tracks_answers.py) to these values.

cursor-middle.about: the spectrum of each channel in the middle of the recording

cursor-start.about: at the very start: the window is pushed inside the file

cursor-end.about: at the very end: the window is pushed inside the file

cursor-silent-channel.about: a channel of zeros: its level has no finite value in the old reply

cursor-bands.about: 1/3-octave band levels instead of a spectrum

pair-plain.about: gain, phase and coherence from one channel to the other of one recording

pair-offset-range.about: two recordings placed 0.25 s apart, over a range both cover

pair-resampled.about: a 12 kHz response against an 8 kHz reference: resampled to the reference's rate

pair-silent-reference.about: a silent reference channel: the gain has no value

pair-too-short.about: a range shorter than one FFT: no line, and the status says why
